title: Why Ripple’s $16 trillion payment volume isn’t boosting XRP
summary: Buying XRP doesn’t give you shares in Ripple, although the company’s growing list of new ventures and financial partners makes it easy to assume their fortunes should move together. Ripple can earn a lot of money from those relationships without passing a dollar to token holders, who have no claim on its profits.
